versions.content: J1939TpConnection . transmitter reference in case of broadcast connection In case of a broadcast connection the J1939TpConnection shall only reference the J1939TpNode in the role transmitter . The reason is that BAM (Broadcast Announce Message) is always directed at the target address 0xff and therefore no receiver reference is necessary.
